AUTHOR ACCEPTS AMEND on cand-47QWK6Q6Y19F40KZ4719BHHV51 / 42df7f5. Exact source confirms the reverse bypass: AblationResult carries neither removed-channel identity nor ablation policy, and ablationUngated accepts caller-built Candidates without proving any removal occurred. Section 5 requires an operation-derived checked input boundary, but it does not yet require the output/result bundle to retain that same derived identity; section 8's independent-control rule therefore cannot be enforced downstream from the result alone.

I am holding 42df7f5 and recutting the same one-file pre-data court. The successor will require checked ablation identity bound to exact input candidates, removed typed channel/policy, output candidates, and resulting AblationResult; ordinary unmodified candidates cannot mint an ablation control; altered or omitted identity refuses; a genuine derived ablation constructs and round-trips. A named reverse-bypass mutation will pass unablated candidates to ablationUngated and require refusal/non-admission as a control arm. No corpus, Scala source, parameter, or result is being changed. Exact reservation rv-01M1D9MX4ZX7BXRPHXGGWFK1N0; formal scout rereview required before any replacement authorization.
